ActorFrame.InitCommand:
%function(self)
local prof = PROFILEMAN:GetMachineProfile() for pn=0,1 do _G['uksrt_cached_highscore_'..pn] = 0 if GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(pn) then local sco = 0 if GAMESTATE:IsCourseMode() then sco = prof:GetHighScoreForCourseAndTrail( GAMESTATE:GetCurrentCourse(), GAMESTATE:GetCurrentTrail(pn):GetDifficulty() ) else sco = prof:GetHighScoreForSongAndSteps( GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong(), GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSteps(pn):GetDifficulty() ) end if sco then _G['uksrt_cached_highscore_'..pn] = math.floor(sco:GetPercentDP()*10000)/10000 end end end
end

Layer.OnCommand: %function(self) self:x(139+62) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y+(398-240)) self:shadowlength(0) self:zoom(0.5) self:diffuse(1,0.2,0.2,1) self:addx(-320) self:sleep(0.1) self:queuecommand('CalcMine') self:linear(0.2) self:addx(320) end
Layer.CalcMineCommand: %function(self) local MineTxt = SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen():GetChild('MinesTextP1'):GetText() local MinePass = string.gsub(MineTxt, '/.*', '') MinePass = string.gsub(MinePass,' ','') local MineTotal = string.gsub(MineTxt, '^.*/', '') MineTotal = string.gsub(MineTotal,' ','') local MineHit = tostring(tonumber(MineTotal) - tonumber(MinePass)) if tonumber(MineHit) > 0 then self:settext('+'..MineHit) end end
